const std = @import("std");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try tree_sitter_language_pack.process("class Person {\n  name string\n  age int\n}\n\nenum Level {\n  Junior\n  Senior\n}\n\nfunction Greet(p: Person) -> string {\n  p.name\n}\n", "{\"language\":\"baml\"}");

    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});
